conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding quality tech names. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad market and growth exposure.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to cure the concentration mandate breach.
Add to SOXL and SPAL to 6% each, increasing leveraged ETF exposure.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and daily decay from leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
Add to QQQI to 30%, prioritizing income for monthly distributions.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates heavily into income-generating ETFs and broad index funds, cutting high-beta names. While aiming for reliable monthly distributions and low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
